# hestiacp_email_domain (Resource)

Manages a mail domain in HestiaCP.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String)

### Optional

- `user` (String) HestiaCP username that owns this mail domain. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
